messages:
jen: Heads up — mkdocs build failing on snippet-migration branch (PR #482). Getting a parse error when code snippets start with decorator-like lines (e.g. "@redact"). Logs pasted below.

docs-bot: CI failed: mkdocs build error (site build). stderr: 
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/local/bin/mkdocs", line 8, in <module>
    and_then_compile()
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.8/site-packages/mdx/plugin.py", line 234, in parse
    raise MarkdownParseError('Unexpected indent in MDX expression')
MarkdownParseError: Unexpected indent in MDX expression
```

alex: Ugh, seen this. MDX/remark sometimes treats leading "@" lines inside fenced code as JSX/JS import markers. Quick test: wrap the fence with an explicit language tag ("```python") or escape the @ with a backslash.

sara: Interesting — i could serve the site locally without error. Our CI image uses mdx 2.x and a different remark plugin order. Might be a plugin conflict.

alex: Another workaround is to add a tiny preprocessing step that rewrites leading @ in code fences to "\@" before MDX parse, or use raw blocks so MDX doesn't try to interpret it.

mike: Pushed a tiny patch on branch ci-fix/preescape that adds a regex to the mdx-loader to prefix leading @ with a backslash inside triple-fenced blocks. Quick smoke test passes: no parse error.

jen: I pushed a tweak to PR #482 switching the snippet include to use an explicit raw wrapper: 
```html
<!-- raw -->
```
so MDX won't touch the contents. @mike can you re-run CI?

docs-bot: CI triggered for commit 8a4d3b1 by jen.

mike: Re-ran — CI shows site build passed on my branch. diff is tiny: we only modify how snippet is embedded.

docs-bot: Build succeeded: deployment pipeline finished (site build ok).

sara: :thumbsup: thanks. Can we add a note to the migration guide about this MDX quirk? People migrating snippet includes might hit it if their examples start with decorators or @mentions.

jen: Good idea. I'll add a short section titled "MDX snippet caveats" and call out decoractor/@ lines and the raw wrapper option. Assigning wording to @sara.

sara: On it. I'll also update a couple of examples in the snippets folder to include explicit language tags (```python) to be safer.

alex: Optional follow-up: open an issue upstream against the mdx remark plugin; this behaviour seems surprising. I can draft one if you want.

jen: Please do, @alex. Link it from the PR so reviewers see it's tracked.

mike: All green from my side, will merge after today's release window. :shipit:

jen: Thanks everyone. I'll wait on the migration-guide commit and the upstream issue link before merging PR.#482.
